meta.title: Reliz — The demand for detail, the emotion of the result
meta.description: Reliz creates complete experiences around hospitality, events and gastronomy. One point of contact, from idea to event.

hero.tagline: The demand for detail, the emotion of the result.
hero.subtitle: Hospitality, events & client experience

vision.title: An identity, not just a services website
vision.text: The goal is not to create a simple services website, but a true identity around hospitality, events and client experience. Reliz conveys something elegant, modern, fluid, human, immersive — premium without being cold.

promise.title: From idea to event
promise.text: A client can arrive with an idea… and leave with a fully created and organised event. One point of contact capable of coordinating everything.

founder.title: The founder
founder.name: Elize Rapisarda
founder.intro: Reliz was created by Elize Rapisarda. I come from the world of events, hospitality and HORECA.
founder.experience: I developed my experience between Luxembourg, the Greater Region and Latin America, primarily in fine dining service, team management, event coordination, bars & cocktails, gastronomy, and venue management.
founder.insight: Today, many events lack fluidity, coherence and above all a human experience.
founder.mission: The idea behind Reliz is to bring together service, organisation, aesthetics, gastronomy and innovation in a single experience. I want Reliz to be perceived as a brand capable of transforming an event into something truly alive, elegant and memorable.

goal.title: Our ambition
goal.imageAlt: Reliz event experience — hospitality and emotion
goal.text: To quickly understand that Reliz is not just an event provider, but a brand capable of creating complete experiences around service, hospitality, gastronomy and emotion.

partners.title: Our collaborations
partners.subtitle: Credibility, field experience and premium positioning.

reliz.title: Reliz — A complete experience
reliz.intro: The most important point in Reliz's positioning is the ability to manage an event in its entirety. A client can arrive with an idea… and leave with a fully created and organised event.
reliz.interlocutor: One point of contact capable of coordinating everything.
scope: Full operational coordination of the event

innovation.title: Digital innovation
innovation.imageAlt: Reliz digital solution — QR code and event experience
innovation.intro: With a team of developers, I am currently developing a digital solution designed to enhance the client experience during events.
innovation.principle: Each table or zone will have a QR code that guests can scan in multiple languages.
features: Send certain requests directly to the teams
goals: To facilitate communication with an international clientele
To support teams when language becomes a barrier
To deliver a more modern, high-end experience
innovation.note: This is something I am beginning to see emerge in certain concepts and that I truly wish to develop within the Reliz event universe.

brooklyn.title: Brooklyn
brooklyn.subtitle: International street food
brooklyn.intro: Brooklyn is the international street food branch developed by Reliz. The concept is presented broadly and modernly, around culinary discovery, sharing and world cuisine.

collection.title: Wedding cars
collection.intro: Reliz also wishes to offer a classic car service for weddings. The idea is not traditional car rental, but rather adding an aesthetic and emotional experience to events.

families.title: Meals for busy families
families.intro: Reliz will also develop a homemade meal offering for families who lack time in their daily lives.
concept: Designed to simplify family life without compromising culinary quality
families.model: 3 menus per week, for 3 people, at a price of €130.

partners.title: Our collaborations
partners.text: It is important to highlight my collaborations with Zandbergen Event Catering, Festin and other premium partners. This brings credibility, field experience and strengthens the brand's premium positioning.

collaborations.title: Our collaborations
collaborations.intro: Reliz relies on a network of selected partners and collaborations to strengthen gastronomic excellence, hospitality and the event experience.

cocktail.title: Cocktail Experience by RELIZ
cocktail.description: Reliz offers a professional bar and cocktail service for events: professional bartenders, mobile bars, signature cocktails, classic cocktails, wedding bars, garden parties, corporate afterworks, private parties and premium bar service.
cocktail.imageAlt: Cocktail Experience by RELIZ — professional bartender

essence.title: Essence Culinaire by Mikel Quesada
essence.subtitle: Training & Consulting
essence.description: Training, gastronomic consulting, operational improvement, culinary standardisation and creation of modern concepts for hospitality, catering and events.
essence.imageAlt: Essence Culinaire by Mikel Quesada — event table setting

festin.title: Festin Traiteur Belgium
festin.description: Belgian gastronomic partner specialising in premium catering for weddings, banquets, BBQ concepts, private events, receptions and personalised gastronomic celebrations.

zandbergen.title: Zandbergen Eventcatering Luxembourg
zandbergen.description: Professional collaboration with Zandbergen Eventcatering, a recognised Luxembourg company for its food concepts, large events, live cooking, weddings, corporate events and premium catering.

vinsmoselle.title: Domaine Vinsmoselle Luxembourg
vinsmoselle.description: Collaboration on gastronomic events linked to a major Luxembourg wine reference. Ideal for wine events, corporate receptions, premium networking, private celebrations and gastronomy & wine experiences.
vinsmoselle.imageAlt: Domaine Vinsmoselle Luxembourg — vineyard at sunset

chateau.title: Château du Pont d'Oye
chateau.subtitle: Belgium
chateau.description: Premium venue for weddings, private celebrations and exclusive events in Belgium. An elegant setting for hospitality, catering, decoration and high-end gastronomic experiences.
chateau.imageAlt: Château du Pont d'Oye — reception hall in Belgium

mikel.label: 04 — External culinary collaboration
mikel.title: Chef Mikel Quesada
mikel.subtitle: Founder of Essence Culinaire by Mikel Quesada
mikel.description: Chef Mikel Quesada collaborates externally with Reliz through Essence Culinaire by Mikel Quesada — Training & Consulting. This collaboration brings recognised expertise in training, gastronomic consulting and operational excellence to projects carried by the brand.
mikel.disclaimer: Mikel Quesada is not an owner of Reliz. He collaborates externally with the company through Essence Culinaire by Mikel Quesada.
